data.long_meaning: Erlinna is derived from the Greek words eros (love) and lampros (bright, shining), and from the Latin word stellare (to shine like a star). This name symbolizes a love that shines brightly and illuminates the world. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Erlinna usually hope their child will grow to embody light, star and live with faith, good character and purpose.
